overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Commission's account that only two members and non-member staff attended the referenced meeting was credited, so no quorum deliberated.

allegations.summary: Alleged a quorum of the Commission deliberated outside a posted meeting, based on a consultant's remark that he met the Chair and 'a few others' outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that a quorum of the Commission was not present at the relevant meeting and therefore no deliberation occurred.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
